title: Crispy Prawn Spring Rolls with Shiitake and Cabbage
summary: Crisp fried wrappers are packed with juicy prawns, shiitake and shredded cabbage for a light, savoury roll served with a sweet chilli dip.

ingredients.item: raw peeled prawns, deveined and chopped
spring onions, whites and greens sliced separately
finely shredded white cabbage and carrot

steps.title: Aromatics
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a non-stick frying pan on medium-high and cook the spring onion whites, garlic and ginger for 1 minute.

steps.title: Filling
steps.text: Add the cabbage and carrot mix, shiitake mushrooms, soy sauce, sugar and vinegar and cook until the cabbage just softens, about 3 minutes.

steps.title: Prawns
steps.text: Stir in the chopped prawns and cook for 1-2 minutes until just pink and opaque, reaching 63°C.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Off the heat, stir in the sesame oil and spring onion greens, spread on a plate and chill for about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Wrap
steps.text: Set a wrapper as a diamond, spoon a packed 80 ml of filling onto the lower half and shape into a log, then wet the edges, fold the bottom corner over, fold in the sides and roll up tightly to seal.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Heat the frying oil to 160°C on medium and fry the rolls seam side down, turning, until golden, 2-4 minutes per side.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Drain, cool for 5 minutes and serve with sweet chilli sauce.

tips: Cook the prawns just until pink and opaque, reaching 63°C, so they stay tender rather than rubbery.
Chill the filling before wrapping so it holds together neatly inside the wrapper.
Keep the rolled spring rolls under damp kitchen paper while you work, so the wrappers stay pliable and don't crack.
safety: Frying safety: use a heavy, deep pot no more than half full of oil, with a clip-on thermometer, and dry the food before it goes in. Never leave hot oil unattended. If the oil catches fire, turn off the heat and cover the pot with a metal lid or use a fire extinguisher; never use water.
storage: Best eaten freshly fried; leftovers keep in the fridge for up to a day and can be recrisped in a hot oven. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
